plan: Drive: from District of Tumbler Ridge, about 100 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 55.64893, -121.56018, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 60 m S, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip). Also: elk, deer (see evidence).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-21, Region 7B. Season: moose spike fork, tripalm or 10 point bulls Oct 25 to Oct 26 and more rows (synopsis page 62, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
